description: A Minecraft mod that gives you an opportunity to recover from a lethal fall.

mods.name: Stored Fall Damage
mods.description: Survive a fatal fall at half a heart, but don't expect all that extra damage to disappear! Does things other than fall damage too if you'd like.

releases.notes:
## Additions/Changes:
- Updated to NeoForge 1.21.1
- Thanks to NeoForge, we have a config screen built-in
- Added particles for Storing Shield, as well as particles while you're storing damage
- Added sounds for storing damage through an active Storing Shield, as well as for taking damage (and dying) after storing damage
- Added a license file

## Compat Changes:
- "Removed" CWSM compatibility. This will be readded upon the release of the 1.21.1 version of CWSM: Renovation
- Added "Raised" compatibility: cracked hearts will now obey Raised moving the hotbar position

## Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug that allowed you to store more damage than defined by the limit by taking damage protected by Storing Shield

releases.notes:
## Additions
- Added "Storing Shield", an effect that prevents taking damage from certain sources to prevent dying shortly after hitting the ground.
- Added "Unstable Hearts", an effect which instantly kills a player if they haven't recovered their stored hearts by the time the effect expires.

## Changes
- All variants of water bucket now count as clutch items for fall damage. No more breaking your legs because of a tadpole in your bucket!
- Expanded the mod to allow for additional damage types to be protected from. Each damage type can also have their own "clutch" items defined, as well as protecting from different sources of damage via Stored Shield!
- Changed the mod icon, the old one honestly sucked
